Keep the catalogs' marks: “…” and ’ in English; «…» in Spanish and Catalan; ’ in Catalan; … as one character (U+2026); ICU plurals as written. packages.title: Microphone permission: a reason before Android asks, «blocked» on both paths, one filled way to Settings, start failures go online
brief: Context. The capture sheet asks for the microphone in `_startRecording` (`App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:942-971`). On the on-device path it asks the app's own bridge, `_speech.permission()` (`App/lib/services/native_speech.dart:135`; `NativeSpeechBridge.kt:85-94`), which answers granted, denied or blocked. On the online path — Voz «En línea, al terminar», phones without on-device recognition, and languages the phone can't recognise itself (Catalan on the emulator) — it asks `_recorder!.hasPermission()`, which only answers yes or no. The emulator captures `App/build/ux/device/permission-mic.*` show the problems below (emulator evidence).

UX-107 (S3, reopened). Ask through the bridge on both paths: replace the `_recorder!.hasPermission()` branch (:956-960) with `_speech.permission()`, so a second refusal on the online path sets `_micBlocked` exactly as on the on-device path. The bridge is app code and works whatever the recognizer; don't add a second permission API. Coming back from Settings with the microphone allowed still starts listening (`_checkMicrophone`), on both paths.

UX-1303 (S2), the blocked state. While `_micBlocked`: hide «Empezar a hablar» (`captureStartTalking`; today the focused filled button at :1944-1949, which re-asks and gets no dialog); make «Abrir Ajustes» (`captureOpenSettings`; today a small text button at :2051-2064) the one full-width FilledButton, with the autofocus; keep «Escribir» and Cancelar where they are. The banner uses the neutral MessageBanner style (not `isError`, not red), keeps the mic-off icon, and `captureMicrophoneBlocked` becomes EN “To dictate again, open Settings and tap Permissions › Microphone › Allow.” / ES «Para volver a dictar, abre Ajustes y toca Permisos › Micrófono › Permitir.» / CA «Per tornar a dictar, obre Configuració i toca Permisos › Micròfon › Permet.» TalkBack focus starts on «Abrir Ajustes».

UX-1305 (S2), part 1, the reason. While Android's microphone question is open — the permission isn't granted yet and the request is pending — replace the disabled «Listo» (:1984-1991) with one line, new key `captureMicrophoneWhy`: EN “Allow the microphone to dictate your tasks. It only listens while you dictate.” / ES «Permite el micrófono para dictar tus tareas. Solo escucha mientras dictas.» / CA «Permet el micròfon per dictar les tasques. Només escolta mentre dictes.» Read the status before asking (permission_handler's `Permission.microphone.status`, already imported at :17), so a normal start with the permission granted never shows the line, not even for a frame. The emulator captures show the sheet's bottom under Android's dialog at 1× and 2×, so the line costs no tap.

UX-1305, part 2, after a refusal that isn't blocked: `captureMicrophone` becomes EN “Without the microphone I can’t hear you. Tap Start talking to allow it, or Type instead.” / ES «Sin micrófono no puedo escucharte. Toca Empezar a hablar para permitirlo, o Escribir.» / CA «Sense micròfon no et puc escoltar. Toca Comença a parlar per permetre-ho, o Escriu.», in the same neutral banner style: refusing is a choice, not an error (OL-2). It names the two buttons that are there; there is no field below.

UX-1306 (S2), start failures go online. When the on-device start fails with the language error (`speechLanguage`), `speechUnavailable`, or any error before `ready` (:1087-1099; `native_speech.dart:26`), switch this sheet to the online path (`_nativeMode = false`) and start listening again at once, with no message and no extra tap. Voz already promises it: «Este teléfono no puede con este idioma por sí solo, así que TaskFlow lo hace en línea.», and Voz shows online whenever the phone can't do the language (`App/lib/screens/voice_settings_screen.dart:92`). Remember «not usable» for that language for the rest of the session (the capability cache of UX-603, `NativeSpeech.knownCapability` / `remember`), so the next sheet starts online. Only if the online start also fails, show one line that replaces both `captureSpeechLanguage` and `captureSpeechUnavailable` (delete those two keys): new key `captureCantListen`, EN “I can’t listen on this phone right now. Tap Type instead.” / ES «Ahora no puedo escucharte en este teléfono. Toca Escribir.» / CA «Ara no et puc escoltar en aquest telèfon. Toca Escriu.» The switch doesn't cost a free account a second dictation. Leave the Kotlin capability probe (`NativeSpeechBridge.kt:124`) as it is.

Previews: add `capture/sheet.mic-blocked` (on-device and online), `capture/sheet.mic-denied` and, if the fakes can hold the request open, `capture/sheet.mic-asking`, in ES and CA at 1× and 2× (App/test/ux_previews/capture_previews.dart).
Don't touch: listening, the countdown and its hints (P167), the result (P168), the control rows' layout for Pro and free accounts (P171), `captureOpenSettings`'s wording, Voz.
acceptance: ES, 1× on 360×800, online path (Voz «En línea, al terminar»), the bridge answers blocked: the sheet shows the banner «Para volver a dictar, abre Ajustes y toca Permisos › Micrófono › Permitir.» not in the error colour, one full-width FilledButton «Abrir Ajustes» holding the focus, «Escribir» and «Cancelar», and no «Empezar a hablar».
The same state on the on-device path; and in CA at 2× on 360×800: «Obre Configuració» is the filled button, no «Comença a parlar», and the banner's text isn't cut.
Tapping «Abrir Ajustes» calls the app-settings opener once; when the app resumes with the permission now granted, the sheet starts listening, on both paths.

ES, first start with the permission not granted and the request pending: in place of «Listo» the sheet shows «Permite el micrófono para dictar tus tareas. Solo escucha mientras dictas.»; with the permission already granted, no frame of the start shows that line.

ES, after a refusal that isn't blocked: the banner reads «Sin micrófono no puedo escucharte. Toca Empezar a hablar para permitirlo, o Escribir.», not in the error style, and both «Empezar a hablar» and «Escribir» show; no value in the three catalogs contains «escribe abajo», “type below” or «escriu a sota».

With a fake bridge whose start fails with the language error before ready: the sheet records on the online path, with no error line and no extra tap; a second sheet opened in the same session starts online without trying on-device first.

With the on-device start and then the online start both failing: one line «Ahora no puedo escucharte en este teléfono. Toca Escribir.»; `captureSpeechLanguage` and `captureSpeechUnavailable` are in none of the three ARB files.
The new and changed keys exist in EN, ES and CA with the copy above (catalog test).
deviceChecks: Emulator lane: re-capture `permission-mic.blocked.ca.*` (online path): «Obre Configuració» is the filled button; `permission-mic.dialog.es.*` at 1.0 and 2.0: the reason line shows under Android's dialog; `permission-mic.denied.es.*`.
Phone or emulator, Android 13–15, ES and CA: the steps «Permisos › Micrófono › Permitir» match App info (Android's option reads «Permitir solo mientras se usa la aplicación»).
Phone, Android 12, app in Catalan: Añadir tarea records on the online path with no error.

packages.title: Nothing found: «Volver a decirlo» with an example; listening hints and the countdown say what's true
brief: UX-1301 (S3). When the assistant answers with no task and no command (`App/lib/services/capture_processor.dart:276-278` sets this problem; the failed state's buttons are at `voice_task_screen.dart:1937-1981` and :1326-1357), the sheet shows «No se encontraron tareas. Tus palabras se conservan.», a tonal «Reintentar» that sends the same words and gets the same answer, and a filled «Guardar como tarea» that saves «Bueno, a ver, no sé» as an undated task (render `capture/sheet.error-nothing-understood.es.light.1x.png`). Newcomers often test with a phrase that isn't a task, so this is often their first dictation. For this problem only:

(a) The one filled button is «Volver a decirlo» (`captureSayAgain`): it clears the words and starts listening on a fresh capture, exactly as «Volver a decirlo» does on a result. When voice isn't available (no dictations left), «Escribir» (`captureTypeInstead`) takes that place, as on a result (UX-614). (b) «Guardar como tarea» (`captureSaveAsWritten`) stays, as a TextButton under it. (c) No «Reintentar» for this problem; offline, unavailable and slow keep theirs. (d) Typed words (Pro typing) keep the editable field and «Listo» instead of «Volver a decirlo». (e) `captureNoTasks` becomes EN `I didn’t find a task. Say what and when, for example: “Tomorrow, call the dentist.”` / ES `No he encontrado ninguna tarea. Di qué y cuándo, por ejemplo: «Mañana, llamar al dentista».` / CA `No he trobat cap tasca. Digues què i quan, per exemple: «Demà, trucar al dentista».` — the example matches the first-run typed example (UX-703). It stays a live region, announced once.
Whether such a dictation should count against the 10 free dictations is the owner's question D4 (UX-1624, server-side): don't change counting.

UX-1304 (S2), what listening says. (a) On the on-device path with no words heard yet, the 5-second hint (:1915-1923; today `captureStillListening` «Sigo escuchando. Toca Listo cuando termines.» while «Listo» is disabled) becomes a new key `captureNothingHeardYet`: EN “Nothing heard yet. Speak when you’re ready, or tap Type instead.” / ES «Aún no he oído nada. Habla cuando quieras o toca Escribir.» / CA «Encara no he sentit res. Parla quan vulguis o toca Escriu.» Once words are heard, `captureStillListening` stays as it is. (b) The countdown counts (:923-935; today «Quedan 10 segundos» from 50 s to 60 s, still at 00:57 on the emulator): `captureTimeLeft` takes the seconds left (60 − elapsed), updated each second from 50 s: EN “{seconds, plural, =1{1 second left} other{{seconds} seconds left}}” / ES «{seconds, plural, =1{Queda 1 segundo} other{Quedan {seconds} segundos}}» / CA «{seconds, plural, =1{Queda 1 segon} other{Queden {seconds} segons}}». TalkBack hears it once, at 50 s (AC-11), not every second. (c) At 60 s with nothing heard, the on-device path shows the existing `captureNoSpeech` («No te he entendido. Vuelve a intentarlo o escríbelo.»), as the online path already does, instead of silently returning to «Empezar a hablar»; and it doesn't announce «Listo» (:1166-1167). (d) On the online path (recorder), from the start of listening, one line, new key `captureListeningOnline`: EN “I’m listening. You’ll see your words when you tap Done.” / ES «Te escucho. Verás tus palabras al tocar Listo.» / CA «T’escolto. Veuràs les paraules quan toquis Fet.» It replaces the on-device hints on that path, where no words appear while speaking.
UX-1322 (S1). While «Entendiendo…», `_ring` (:2175-2201) shows the spinner alone, without the microphone glyph; the microphone shows only while listening.

Don't touch: free-dictation counting; what «Guardar como tarea» does (U7, D3 of the commands run); the other failed states; the permission states (P166); the result (P168); the control rows' layout (P171).

packages.title: The result at large text: the open question's answers in view, «Ver lo que dije» in the scroll, 48 dp day lines, a spoken summary
brief: UX-1302 (S3). At 2× on 360 dp the result's pinned footer (`voice_task_screen.dart:3694-3816`: the filled button, Cancelar / Volver a decirlo, and «Ver lo que dije» at :3789) takes about 280 of 752 dp. The AM/PM question's chips «05:00 · 17:00 · Sin hora» sit out of view and the box is cut under the question (renders `capture/result.question.{es,ca}.light.2x.png`); the button reads «Revisa los datos de arriba». In `commands/cards.mixed.es.light.2x.png` the card the button will delete is below the fold too.

(a) When a result shows, and after each answer to a question, scroll the first card that holds an open question or a blocking choice (an AM/PM or day question, a project question, a pick list) into view, aligned to the bottom of the scroll area so its answers show (`Scrollable.ensureVisible` with alignment 1.0; jump, with no animation, when `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf` is true). With nothing open, the scroll stays at the top, as today. (b) Move «Ver lo que dije» (and «Texto original» for typed words) out of the pinned footer to the end of the scrolling cards. The pinned footer keeps only the filled button and Cancelar / Volver a decirlo.

UX-1312 (S2). On a several-task result each compact card's day line (`App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:366-397`) is a 286 × 40 dp button (`dense`, `VisualDensity.compact`) with no chevron (AUDIT `capture/result · several`: 3 targets under 48 dp), while the single-task line, the same control, is 56 dp with a chevron. Drop `dense` and the compact density so the row is at least 48 dp tall, and show the main line's trailing chevron (20 dp) on compact cards too.

UX-1308 (S2). `CaptureResult.initState` (:2341-2356) announces nothing, so with TalkBack the result replaces the focused «Listo» in silence and the date — the most important line — is never spoken. After the result's first frame, send one polite announcement without moving focus: one task: «{title}, {date line}», the date line as the card shows it (e.g. «Llamar al médico, vie, 23 de oct · 10:00»); several: `captureThingsToAdd(n)`; when a question is open, append the question's text. No new strings.
Don't touch: the cards' contents and copy, the button's labels, the keep question; the gaps between the footer's buttons (P171 sets them after this package).

A two-task result where both tasks ask a question: after tapping «17:00» on the first, the second question's chips are in view.

The pinned footer holds only the filled button and Cancelar / Volver a decirlo; «Ver lo que dije» is the last item inside the scrolling cards and still opens the words.
With animations off, the reveal jumps (no intermediate scroll offsets).
ES, a three-task result at 1×: each compact card's day line is at least 48 dp tall and shows a chevron; AUDIT for `capture/result · several` lists no target under 48 dp.

Semantics: a one-task result sends one announcement containing the title and the date line; a three-task result sends «3 cosas para añadir»; an AM/PM result's announcement ends with the question; the focused node doesn't change.

packages.title: Calendar after a save and on return: lit rows clear the message, every new row in view, today after a while away, an empty day said once
brief: UX-1309 (S3; merged UX-1401, review B). `_reveal` (`App/lib/screens/calendar_screen.dart:158-220`) clears a dated landing by a fixed 88 dp (`math.max(88, _end)`, :192); only a no-date landing measures the save message (`_messageClearance()`, :246-265, UX-475), as Tareas does for every landing (`home_screen.dart:290-293`); and only the first lit row carries `_landedRow` (:353-355, :781). So at 2× the 4-line message (about 203 dp) covers the lit row's second line (`calendar/agenda.added.es.light.2x.png`, `commands/applied.change-applied.es.light.2x.png`); at 1× a 3-line message reaches the lit row (`commands/applied.mixed-applied.es.light.1x.png`); and a second task saved for the same day («Recoger a los niños del colegio», 17:00, in the three-task fixture `App/test/ux_previews/capture_previews.dart:139-147`) is lit but out of view (`agenda.added.es.light.1x.png`). U5 asks for the saved task visible and highlighted, every time.

(a) Every landing, dated or not, clears the measured message height + 8 dp, waiting for the message the way the no-date landing does; keep 88 dp only as the fallback when no message is found. (b) When several lit rows are on the day shown, reveal the block from the first to the last lit row if it fits above the message; otherwise reveal the first. (c) The 1.5 s fade starts only for lit rows that are in view; a lit row out of view stays lit until it is scrolled into view, then fades 1.5 s later (reduced motion as today). No copy change.

UX-1405 (S2). `_followToday` (:101-106) moves only a Calendar left on today (UX-203), so a day chosen by a landing (:140-147) or tapped by the person stays selected on every later open while Android keeps the app in memory, after midnight too (resume at :268-277). On Monday night «Médico el viernes» lands on Friday; on Tuesday morning the app opens on Friday. When the app comes back after 30 minutes or more away, or on a new day, select today and clear `_picked`: note the time when the app goes to the background and compare on resume, both through `calendarClockProvider`. Shorter returns keep the day, so a picked day still reaches the next capture (UX-602, D9). No copy change.

UX-1404 (S2). In an 80 dp cell that leaves 44 dp for two lines, which two 9 sp lines at 2.0 (about 21 dp each) fit. Settled: review A's auto-size with review D's 24 dp mic; review D's mic beside the label would leave about 36 dp of width in a 1×1 cell, too narrow for «Dictar» at 2.0, and A's 14 sp maximum would change the widget at 1.0.

brief: UX-1601 (S3), D1 answered on 2026-10-20 (DECISIONS.md): ask only after a save whose reminder can still fire, with no new copy; a date-only task for today saved after 9:00 gets no reminder, and its chip stops promising «9:00»; one default, no new rule (TA-5). (b) The chip and the form's row. No engine change: what it schedules stays as it is (a past alert is already dropped), and there is no later default reminder: the owner chose no new rule.

packages.title: Activity: an unread row's spoken label holds still while it waits
brief: Batch b4's leftover (main session, 2026-10-20). It runs in batch b5. UX-1648 (S2) is regression R3C-1 from P213 (verify-b4-r3-C.md), raised in b4's last round, so it wasn't re-planned. Tapping an unread Activity row whose task isn't on the phone yet starts the row's wait, and marks the item read. Marking it read reloads the list while the row is still waiting, so «No leída» drops out of the row's merged label mid-wait. TalkBack then likely reads the whole row a second time. From the tap until the wait ends, the row's merged semantics label stays one value, across that reload. Don't touch: P213's waiting bar and its copy (UX-1646, UX-1647); the bold title of unread rows; the row's layout; the mark-read call; the rest of Activity.

decisions.question: The reminder question when no reminder can come (UX-1601, S3; review D's question 2, D2a and D2b). The one-time «¿Quieres un recordatorio antes?» comes after the account's first dated save. When that task is for today and saved after 9:00 (date-only tasks remind at 9:00), or is a timed task already inside its lead time, «Sí, recuérdamelo» ends with «Listo. Recordatorios activados.», the chip still reads «Recordatorio: 9:00», and no reminder ever comes — the first reminder is where trust is made. (a) Should the question wait for the first dated task a reminder can still serve? (b) Should a date-only task for today saved after 9:00 get a reminder at all?
decisions.recommendation: (a) Yes: ask only after a save whose reminder would still fire once reminders are on; otherwise keep the slot for the next dated save (review D's fix; no new copy). (b) Keep one default and no new rule (TA-5): such a task gets no reminder, and its chip stops promising «9:00»; the wording comes with the package once you answer. If you'd rather it reminded later the same day, say when (an hour after saving, or 18:00). Evidence: code, plus emulator captures of the sheet for a task dated tomorrow; the today-after-9:00 case is inferred and needs a phone check.
decisions.answer: Answered 2026-10-20, as recommended (DECISIONS.md): ask only after a save whose reminder can still fire, with no new copy; a date-only task for today saved after 9:00 gets no reminder, and its chip says so. Built by P190.

decisions.question: Sign-in's first screen (UX-1603, S2; review D's question 3, D8). The only filled, coloured button submits email and password; Google, 2 taps to Calendar, is a white outlined button above an «o». The screen has 10 tap targets and asks two things at once (Google or email; sign in or create), and the email path for a new person is about 7 actions plus the inbox. Fold the email fields behind one text button, «Continuar con mi correo» / “Continue with email” / «Continua amb el correu», under «Continuar con Google»?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. Targets 10 → 5, decisions 2 → 1; people who sign in by email tap once more. The form stays open for sign-in-again, after returning from create or recovery, and while one of its errors shows. If you want the fields always visible instead, the email submit becomes a tonal button so Google is the one filled button. Google stays first either way (D8). Which path newcomers take is inferred: the §7 test will show it. P170 fixes the screen's other problems now and doesn't pre-empt this.
decisions.answer: Answered 2026-10-20: yes, the email fields fold behind «Continuar con mi correo». Built by P193, after P170 and P191.

decisions.question: Dates in shared text, and a default day in the form (UX-1623, S2; reviews A and B, question 1; SEEN #7). Sharing «Comprar pan y leche el viernes» to TaskFlow opens the form with no day; one Back saves it to Sin fecha with «el viernes» in its title, and no reminder (emulator `share.landing`, `share.after-back`). From Calendar's today, a typed task with no chip tapped also goes to Sin fecha. Your 2026-10-18 rules read dictated words for dates (D2) but leave typing as typed, and shares fall between the two. (a) Keep it; (b) read the day and time in shared text, as D2 does for dictated words — they're someone else's words, not the person's typing; (c) also preselect «Hoy» when the form opens from Calendar's today.
decisions.recommendation: (b), and keep the form's empty default otherwise, which matches D9 for dictation. Optional, from review B: with no day chosen, the form's button says where the task goes, «Añadir sin fecha» / “Add with no date” / «Afegeix sense data». This has been with you since 2026-10-18 as «a default day in the form»; the shares are the new evidence.
decisions.answer: Answered 2026-10-20: read the day and time in shared text; the form's empty default otherwise. Built by P192. Review B's optional «Añadir sin fecha» isn't part of the answer and isn't planned.

decisions.question: Should a dictation in which nothing was found use one of the 10 free dictations? (UX-1624, S2; review A's question 2.) decisions.question: A way to change your name (UX-1515, with UX-1612's name half; S2; review C's question 3, review D's question 7, D8). A password account is asked for a first name once, at its first share or join. «Ahora no», Back, a swipe, a typo, or an accepted unaccented suggestion («Maria» for María) is final: every member then sees the email prefix or the typo on chips, «Creada por», assignments and Novedades, and Google accounts can't change Google's name either. Add one row in Cuenta?

One row on a rare screen, nothing on the default path. P189 already puts the name where Cuenta's slogan is.

decisions.question: Phone calendars after connecting (UX-1611, the default; S2; review D's question 6). decisions.question: The launcher icon (UX-1608, S2; review D's question 4; SEEN #13). Android draws the non-adaptive icon shrunk inside a white disc: a dark badge with an «M», about 26 dp of a 61 dp icon, beside Gmail's «M» in the dock. Inside the app, the mark is a teal square with a white double tick. Redraw the adaptive icon from the in-app mark, or keep the «M» artwork as an adaptive icon?

decisions.question: Reminder titles on the lock screen (UX-1625, S1; review D's question 1; NO-9 makes it yours).
